Table traces

Source: R/zz-gen-figure.R, R/zz-gen-table.R
go_table.Rd

Table view for detailed data viewing. The data are arranged in a grid of rows and columns. Most styling can be specified for columns, rows or individual cells. Table is using a column-major order, ie. the grid is represented as a vector of column vectors.

  ...,

  cells = NULL,
  columnorder = NULL,

Arguments

fig

A go_figure object.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

data

A data frame in which formula properties (e.g. x = ~col, marker_size = ~col) are evaluated. Default: the data given to go_figure(). Only the evaluated values are added to the trace.

cells

Named list or go_table_cells() object.

columnorder

Specifies the rendered order of the data columns; for example, a value `2` at position `0` means that column index `0` in the data will be rendered as the third column, as columns have an index base of zero. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

columnwidth

The width of columns expressed as a ratio. Columns fill the available width in proportion of their specified column widths. Number, or a vector of these.

customdata

Assigns extra data each datum. This may be useful when listening to hover, click and selection events. Note that, "scatter" traces also appends customdata items in the markers DOM elements Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

domain

Named list or go_table_domain() object.

header

Named list or go_table_header() object.

hoverinfo

Determines what trace information appears on hover. If `none` or `skip` are set, no information is displayed upon hovering. But, if `none` is set, click and hover events are still fired. Any combination of "x", "y", "z", "text", "name" joined with "+", or one of "all", "none", "skip", or a vector of these.

hoverlabel

Named list or go_table_hoverlabel() object.

ids

Assigns id labels to each datum. These ids for object constancy of data points during animation. Should be an array of strings, not numbers or any other type. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

legend

Sets the reference to a legend to show this trace in. References to these legends are "legend", "legend2", "legend3", etc. Settings for these legends are set in the layout, under `layout.legend`, `layout.legend2`, etc. Subplot id: "legend", "legend2", "legend3", ....

legendgrouptitle

Named list or go_table_legendgrouptitle() object.

legendrank

Sets the legend rank for this trace. Items and groups with smaller ranks are presented on top/left side while with "reversed" `legend.traceorder` they are on bottom/right side. The default legendrank is 1000, so that you can use ranks less than 1000 to place certain items before all unranked items, and ranks greater than 1000 to go after all unranked items. When having unranked or equal rank items shapes would be displayed after traces i.e. according to their order in data and layout. Number.

legendwidth

Sets the width (in px or fraction) of the legend for this trace. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

meta

Assigns extra meta information associated with this trace that can be used in various text attributes. Attributes such as trace `name`, graph, axis and colorbar `title.text`, annotation `text` `rangeselector`, `updatemenues` and `sliders` `label` text all support `meta`. To access the trace `meta` values in an attribute in the same trace, simply use `%{meta[i]}` where `i` is the index or key of the `meta` item in question. To access trace `meta` in layout attributes, use `%{data[n[.meta[i]}` where `i` is the index or key of the `meta` and `n` is the trace index. Any value.

name

Sets the trace name. The trace name appears as the legend item and on hover. String.

uid

Assign an id to this trace, Use this to provide object constancy between traces during animations and transitions. String.

uirevision

Controls persistence of some user-driven changes to the trace: `constraintrange` in `parcoords` traces, as well as some `editable: true` modifications such as `name` and `colorbar.title`. Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Note that other user-driven trace attribute changes are controlled by `layout` attributes: `trace.visible` is controlled by `layout.legend.uirevision`, `selectedpoints` is controlled by `layout.selectionrevision`, and `colorbar.(x|y)` (accessible with `config: {editable: true}`) is controlled by `layout.editrevision`. Trace changes are tracked by `uid`, which only falls back on trace index if no `uid` is provided. So if your app can add/remove traces before the end of the `data` array, such that the same trace has a different index, you can still preserve user-driven changes if you give each trace a `uid` that stays with it as it moves. Any value.

visible

Determines whether or not this trace is visible. If "legendonly", the trace is not drawn, but can appear as a legend item (provided that the legend itself is visible). One of "legendonly", TRUE, FALSE.

row

add_table(): Subplot grid row (figures created with make_subplots() only). May be "all" or a vector to address several cells.

go_table_domain(): If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this row in the grid for this table trace. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

col

Subplot grid column (figures created with make_subplots() only). May be "all" or a vector to address several cells.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

align

go_table_cells(), go_table_header(): Sets the horizontal alignment of the `text` within the box. Has an effect only if `text` spans two or more lines (i.e. `text` contains one or more <br> HTML tags) or if an explicit width is set to override the text width. One of "left", "center", "right", or a vector of these.

go_table_hoverlabel(): Sets the horizontal alignment of the text content within hover label box. Has an effect only if the hover label text spans two or more lines One of "left", "right", "auto", or a vector of these.

fill

go_table_cells(): Named list or go_table_cells_fill() object.

go_table_header(): Named list or go_table_header_fill() object.

font

go_table_cells(): Named list or go_table_cells_font() object.

go_table_header(): Named list or go_table_header_font() object.

go_table_hoverlabel(): Sets the font used in hover labels. Named list or go_table_hoverlabel_font() object.

go_table_legendgrouptitle(): Sets this legend group's title font. Named list or go_table_legendgrouptitle_font() object.

format

Sets the cell value formatting rule using d3 formatting mini-languages which are very similar to those in Python. For numbers, see: https://github.com/d3/d3-format/tree/v1.4.5#d3-format. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

height

The height of cells. Number.

line

go_table_cells(): Named list or go_table_cells_line() object.

go_table_header(): Named list or go_table_header_line() object.

prefix

Prefix for cell values. String, or a vector of these.

suffix

Suffix for cell values. String, or a vector of these.

values

go_table_cells(): Cell values. `values[m][n]` represents the value of the `n`th point in column `m`, therefore the `values[m]` vector length for all columns must be the same (longer vectors will be truncated). Each value must be a finite number or a string. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

go_table_header(): Header cell values. `values[m][n]` represents the value of the `n`th point in column `m`, therefore the `values[m]` vector length for all columns must be the same (longer vectors will be truncated). Each value must be a finite number or a string. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

color

go_table_cells_fill(), go_table_header_fill(): Sets the cell fill color. It accepts either a specific color or an array of colors or a 2D array of colors. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_cells_line(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_header_line(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

family

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String, or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String.

lineposition

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none", or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none".

shadow

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String, or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String.

size

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Number in the interval [1, Inf], or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Number in the interval [1, Inf].

style

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic", or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic".

textcase

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower", or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower".

variant

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase", or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase".

weight

go_table_cells_font(), go_table_header_font(), go_table_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000], or a vector of these.

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font(): Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000].

width

Number, or a vector of these.

column

If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this column in the grid for this table trace. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

x

Sets the horizontal domain of this table trace (in plot fraction). Vector or list of 2 element(s).

y

Sets the vertical domain of this table trace (in plot fraction). Vector or list of 2 element(s).

bgcolor

Sets the background color of the hover labels for this trace Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

bordercolor

Sets the border color of the hover labels for this trace. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

namelength

Sets the default length (in number of characters) of the trace name in the hover labels for all traces. -1 shows the whole name regardless of length. 0-3 shows the first 0-3 characters, and an integer >3 will show the whole name if it is less than that many characters, but if it is longer, will truncate to `namelength - 3` characters and add an ellipsis. Integer in the interval [-1, Inf], or a vector of these.

showarrow

Sets whether or not to show the hover label arrow/triangle pointing to the data point. Logical.

text

Sets the title of the legend group. String.

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_table() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()). add_table() creates an object and adds it to a figure.

Nested objects documented here:

go_table_header_font()

go_table_header_line()

table.header.line

go_table_hoverlabel()

go_table_hoverlabel_font()

table.hoverlabel.font: Sets the font used in hover labels.

go_table_legendgrouptitle()

go_table_legendgrouptitle_font()

table.legendgrouptitle.font: Sets this legend group's title font.
